title: ChatGPT — Anatomy of an AI conversation client

nodes.question: ChatGPT — Anatomy of an AI conversation client
nodes.why: A prospective book of client-side engineering, with observed mechanisms and explicitly open directions.

nodes.question: Guarded deferred submission
nodes.mechanism_explanation: A deferred send carries a currentness predicate. Callers retain editor document identity and relevant account/navigation state; when readiness changes, the pending action is accepted only if those captured conditions remain true. The guarded send path combines multiple currentness checks rather than treating readiness as blanket permission.
nodes.transferable_insight: A queued action should carry a functional intent and a validity predicate. Capture identity at the beginning of an operation, then revalidate at the side-effect boundary.
nodes.qualification: Observed client call sites and guard checks, not the complete controller implementation or live behavior.

nodes.question: Authored prompt and submission snapshot
nodes.mechanism_explanation: The submit path distinguishes original editor content, text to be restored, submitted editor document, selected uploads and whether to preserve the draft. It assembles the intended prompt and attachment state separately from transient interface state.
nodes.transferable_insight: Treat a submission as a snapshot of user-authored content and associated resources; restoration requires knowing what was submitted, not merely retaining whatever text happens to be in the editor.
nodes.qualification: Partial client preparation path; no complete transport request or rejection recovery implementation established.

nodes.question: Bounded background conversation recovery
nodes.mechanism_explanation: A recovery loop is bound to the account, conversation and active message/request identity. It monitors inactivity and pauses, uses bounded requests and a deadline, limits repeated unsuccessful attempts, and reconciles a refreshed conversation snapshot. A state change can cancel obsolete requests or reset recovery timing.
nodes.transferable_insight: A live stream and an independently recoverable authoritative snapshot are complementary. Recovery should be gated by inactivity, identity and a finite retry budget, not an unconditional polling timer.
nodes.qualification: Static recovery loop only; no test of transport delivery, exact server state transitions or behavior in a suspended Safari tab.

nodes.question: Turn completion and conversation event boundaries
nodes.why: The module index finds turn-completion listener names, conversation-state callbacks, history attachment and stream-delta listeners. This provides evidence of candidate event-oriented boundaries, not a demonstrated event dispatch contract.
nodes.transferable_insight: Distinguish lifecycle events from DOM changes and from persisted message state; use stable event semantics only after confirming their actual contract.
nodes.qualification: Lexical evidence only. No callback implementation or public automation API established.

nodes.question: Message projection and cached derived views
nodes.mechanism_explanation: The inspected code derives display items and turns from message records, distinguishes source records from derived representations, gathers content references and reuses derived results when the relevant inputs and identities have not changed. A WeakMap caches one derived representation by message object.
nodes.transferable_insight: Separate canonical data from its projections. A rich application can construct multiple views without duplicating or mutating the source representation. Invalidation must follow meaningful input changes.
nodes.qualification: Only client conversion excerpts; no full conversation schema or internal rendering protocol established.

nodes.question: Prediction ownership and conditional draft cleanup
nodes.mechanism_explanation: A suggested-text path records the document and persisted text it introduced. Input, paste, drop, composition and submit events retire its ownership. Cleanup clears text only while the tracked document and persisted content remain current; it avoids active composition. A separate route-prefill path consumes a location key once.
nodes.transferable_insight: Treat machine-suggested text as a revocable contribution to a user-owned document. Cleanup must check ownership, not merely whether the suggestion previously existed.
nodes.qualification: No claim that all suggestions follow the same path or that every navigation scenario is covered.

nodes.question: Browser storage and page lifecycle
nodes.why: The module index eventually recovers IndexedDB and visibility-change references in one parsed module. This is a direction for inspecting persistence and lifecycle coordination, not evidence of a particular write-on-hide algorithm.
nodes.transferable_insight: Investigate storage ownership, flush timing, recovery and browser lifecycle as separate dimensions.
nodes.qualification: No implementation excerpt returned for this module; corrected index boundaries do not establish causal relationships.

nodes.question: Attachment readiness and post-await revalidation
nodes.mechanism_explanation: The composer distinguishes pending drops, uploading attachments, prepared files and loading admission information. A path waits for upload-limit data and subsequently verifies cancellation, editor survival, original text, account/navigation state, currentness and continued presence of the intended upload IDs.
nodes.transferable_insight: An attachment becoming ready is not sufficient to authorize its use. Validate the relationship between the resource and the still-current user action after asynchronous work.
nodes.qualification: Upload transport and server-side validation not inspected. No claim that all submissions follow this exact path.

nodes.question: Copy actions and selection feedback
nodes.mechanism_explanation: One callback associates a successful copy with message context and reports selected-text length and action source. Another path observes a copy event only for an eligible noncollapsed selection inside the relevant message and excludes editable fields and temporary chats in that path. The listener has paired cleanup; event deduplication is present.
nodes.transferable_insight: Separate the actual clipboard operation from instrumentation of the user's action. Scope feedback to the right document and message; do not infer copied contents from a length metric.
nodes.qualification: These excerpts concern feedback and event handling, not the exact complete-response serialization, all data collection or privacy policy.

nodes.question: Clipboard representations and rich text transfer
nodes.why: The search returned candidate clipboard paths for Markdown, text, HTML and rich-editor fragments, plus a shared clipboard helper. Native response copying was the original research goal, but the exact whole-turn serializer remains open.
nodes.transferable_insight: Separate content representation, selection extraction and clipboard delivery; each may have different failure conditions.
nodes.qualification: Lexical leads only for these format paths; not proof of MIME support for every copy action.

nodes.question: Browser audio worklets and media lifecycle
nodes.why: A positive-control search found an AudioWorkletNode construction candidate within an identified module. This establishes a specific source landmark for future audio investigations, not the implemented processing graph.
nodes.transferable_insight: Separate capture permissions, audio processing, transport and playback; they fail independently.
nodes.qualification: No inspected audio implementation, background microphone behavior or WebRTC details established.

nodes.question: Connected resources and contextual attachments
nodes.why: Discovery includes external resource references, connector-related payload names and resource/template vocabulary. These are leads toward resource identity and the boundary between an attachment and a live reference.
nodes.transferable_insight: Preserve resource provenance, access scope and identity separately from visible text; don't infer authorization from a client representation.
nodes.qualification: Prospective territory informed by lexical discovery. No underlying tool execution or access control implementation established.

nodes.question: Network transitions and recovery observability
nodes.why: The discovery index contains network-state change and restart-disconnect counters alongside visibility-related references. They offer a direction for examining diagnostic state transitions distinct from actual response recovery.
nodes.transferable_insight: Instrument lifecycle transitions and failure classes rather than merely logging exceptions; correlate signals with user-visible outcomes before claiming causality.
nodes.qualification: Lexical leads only for this diagnostic module; no measured failure rates or complete instrumentation semantics.
